arguments.name: data_source_name
arguments.description: Data Source Name for the MySQL server to connect to.

arguments.name: forward_to
arguments.description: Where to forward log entries after processing.

arguments.name: collect_interval
arguments.description: How frequently to collect information from database.

arguments.name: disable_collectors
arguments.description: A list of collectors to disable from the default set.

arguments.name: disable_query_redaction
arguments.description: Collect unredacted SQL query text including parameters.

arguments.name: enable_collectors
arguments.description: A list of collectors to enable on top of the default set.

arguments.name: explain_plan_collect_interval
arguments.description: How frequently to collect explain plan information from database.

arguments.name: explain_plan_per_collect_ratio
arguments.description: Ratio of explain plan queries to collect per collect interval.

arguments.name: explain_plan_initial_lookback
arguments.description: How far back to look for explain plan queries on the first collection interval.

arguments.name: locks_collect_interval
arguments.description: How frequently to collect locks information from database.

arguments.name: locks_threshold
arguments.description: Threshold for locks to be considered slow. If a lock exceeds this duration, it will be logged.

arguments.name: setup_consumers_collect_interval
arguments.description: How frequently to collect performance_schema.setup_consumers information from the database.
